name_zh: 阿拉法特/巴勒斯坦建国：民族建国与抵抗外交
name_en: Arafat/Palestinian Nation-Building: National Liberation & Resistance Diplomacy
description_zh: 亚西尔·阿拉法特 (1929-2004) 法塔赫创始人、巴解组织主席 (1969-2004)、巴勒斯坦民族权力机构首任主席 (1996-2004)。核心建国逻辑：武装斗争合法性(游击战/焦点理论)→流散动员(难民营/海外巴勒斯坦人/阿拉伯国家支持)→国际外交突围(1974 联大演讲/1988 宣布建国/1993 奥斯陆协议/1994 诺贝尔和平奖)→自治实体建设(巴权机构/安全部队/市政服务)。体现 M170 部落/民族建国——以游击战+流散网络+外交突围三位一体，在无领土/无主权/无军队极限条件下建构民族政治主体。
description_en: Yasser Arafat (1929-2004) Fatah founder, PLO Chairman (1969-2004), PA first President (1996-2004). Core nation-building logic: armed struggle legitimacy (guerrilla/foco theory) -> diaspora mobilization (refugee camps/overseas Palestinians/Arab state support) -> international diplomatic breakout (1974 UNGA speech/1988 declaration of independence/1993 Oslo Accords/1994 Nobel Peace Prize) -> autonomy entity building (PA/security forces/municipal services). Exemplifies M170 Tribal/National Liberation Governance—trinity of guerrilla warfare + diaspora network + diplomatic breakout constructing national political subject under extreme conditions of no territory/no sovereignty/no army.
reason_zh: 巴勒斯坦建国是"无地建国"极限案例：1948 纳克巴流散、1967 全境被占、无主权/无边界/无军队。阿拉法特以"枪杆子+外交舌头+流散网络"三位一体，在以色列/美国/阿拉伯/苏联四强夹缝中争取国际法主体资格。M170 区隔于 M173 哈希姆合法性(血统)、M149 伊斯兰咨询(决策)，核心在于"游击战建国+流散即领土+外交突围"的无地民族建构范式。
reason_en: Palestinian nation-building is 'stateless state-building' extreme case: 1948 Nakba displacement, 1967 full occupation, no sovereignty/no borders/no army. Arafat with trinity of 'gun + diplomatic tongue + diaspora network' carved international legal personality in Israel/US/Arab/USSR four-power squeeze. M170 distinct from M173 Hashemite Legitimacy (lineage) and M149 Islamic Shura (decision), core: 'guerrilla state-building + diaspora as territory + diplomatic breakout' stateless nation-construction paradigm.
steps_zh: 武装斗争确立合法性：1965 法塔赫首次行动/1968 卡拉迈战役/1974 联大"枪与橄榄枝"演讲，游击战成民族代表权来源
流散网络动员领土化：难民营(约旦/黎巴嫩/叙利亚)成准领土、海外巴勒斯坦人(智利/洪都拉斯/欧美)成外交/资助网络、UNRWA 服务成准政府职能
外交突围与国际法主体化：1974 联大观察员/1988 阿尔及尔宣布建国/1993 奥斯陆互认/1994 诺奖/1996 当选主席
自治实体建设与局限：巴权机构/安全部队/市政/教育/卫生，但无主权/无边境控制/无耶路撒冷/定居点持续扩张
遗产与未竟：阿拉法特 2004 逝世/阿布·马祖恩继任/分裂(法塔赫/哈马斯)/两国方案停滞/国际法诉讼/ICC 调查持续
steps_en: Armed struggle establishes legitimacy: 1965 Fatah first op/1968 Karameh battle/1974 UNGA 'gun and olive branch' speech, guerrilla war as source of national representation

Diaspora network mobilizes as territory: refugee camps (Jordan/Lebanon/Syria) as quasi-territory, overseas Palestinians (Chile/Honduras/West) as diplomatic/funding network, UNRWA services as quasi-gov functions
Diplomatic breakout & international legal subjectivity: 1974 UNGA observer/1988 Algiers declaration/1993 Oslo mutual recognition/1994 Nobel/1996 elected President
Autonomy entity construction & limits: PA/security/municipal/education/health, but no sovereignty/no border control/no Jerusalem/settlements keep expanding
Legacy & unfinished: Arafat 2004 death/Abbas succession/split (Fatah/Hamas)/two-state stalled/ICJ proceedings/ICC investigation ongoing
expected_zh: 无领土/无主权/无军队民族以"游击战+流散网络+外交突围"三位一体建构国际法主体，虽未完成建国但确立了巴勒斯坦民族不可逆的政治主体性。
expected_en: Stateless/sovereign-less/army-less nation constructs international legal subjectivity via trinity of 'guerrilla warfare + diaspora network + diplomatic breakout', though statehood incomplete, established Palestinian nation's irreversible political subjectivity.
case_zh: 1964 巴解成立→1969 阿拉法特任主席→1974 联大观察员→1988 宣布建国→1993 奥斯陆/1994 诺奖→2000 坎普大卫失败/第二次起义→2004 阿拉法特逝世→分裂/停滞至今。
case_en: 1964 PLO founded -> 1969 Arafat chairman -> 1974 UNGA observer -> 1988 declaration -> 1993 Oslo/1994 Nobel -> 2000 Camp David failed/Second Intifada -> 2004 Arafat death -> split/stalemate ongoing.
intellectual_tradition: Palestinian National Liberation / Armed Struggle Diplomacy
cross_cultural_impact: National liberation movement template; diaspora as territory concept; armed struggle to diplomacy transition; ICC/ICJ precedent
diaspora_influence: Palestinian diaspora 6M+ (Jordan/Lebanon/Syria/Chile/US/Europe); refugee camps as political units
indigenous_knowledge_system: Palestinian oral history (Nakba testimony); fellahin agricultural calendar; keffiyeh symbolism
